records.document: The receiving party shall keep the disclosed information confidential. This duty continues for five years after disclosure.
records.hypothesis: The receiving party is required to keep the disclosed information confidential.

records.document: A recipient may disclose Protected Information to its employees only when they need it to evaluate the proposed transaction. Each employee must be subject to a confidentiality obligation.
records.hypothesis: A recipient may disclose Protected Information to employees who need it to evaluate the proposed transaction and are bound by confidentiality obligations.

records.document: This Agreement terminates exactly 12 months after the Effective Date. The confidentiality obligations also end on that date.
records.hypothesis: This Agreement terminates exactly 24 months after the Effective Date.

records.document: The Receiving Party must not disclose Confidential Information to any external consultant. No exception for consultants is permitted under this Agreement.
records.hypothesis: The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to external consultants.

records.document: The Receiving Party shall return all written Confidential Information within ten business days after a written request from the Disclosing Party.
records.hypothesis: Disputes under this Agreement are governed by the laws of California.

records.document: The recipient must store each confidential file in an encrypted repository. At least one access review must be conducted every 30 days.
records.hypothesis: The disclosing party must pay a fee of 500 dollars before each access review.
